Skill search works however you open the Skills page: with H, or from the Skills tab of the Character, Backpack, Journal, World or any other menu page.
Game updates: Find now reads where the game keeps item, recipe and menu data from the game itself when it starts, so an update that moves them no longer breaks Find.
Recipes that make more than one item had their extra items read wrongly.
Reported bugs fixed:
Shift+F did nothing on the Skills page opened from the menu's tabs (reported by Naft).
